tasks.short: Determine textile machine setup from instructions and samples

steps.what: Study guides, loom patterns and samples and confer with staff about setup requirements

tasks.design: Retain instruction study, sample examination and setup clarification with the operator, using existing {DOCS} specifications. The supplied cutting and production-dashboard capabilities do not establish automatic interpretation of loom setup requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Setup depends on the actual sample, machine and meaning of the specification.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controlled instructions and direct engineering consultation support the task.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting instructions and material behaviour that differs from a nominal specification.
tasks.human_edge: The operator inspects the sample and asks for clarification before applying settings.
tasks.altitude: Reliable interpretation of textile setup requirements

reach.learn: Explain conflicts between nominal settings and actual sample requirements

evidence.claim: Valia Furniture provides production and maintenance dashboards and marker generation; these capabilities do not demonstrate automatic loom setup interpretation.

assumptions: The baseline is study and clarification, not searching an independently measured document archive or physically setting the machine.
Engineering staff produce specifications through their existing process; the operator obtains explanations and examines samples within s1 with all time retained.
No machine consumes an assumed structured recipe or material suitability flag.
Existing DOCS specifications precede a new answer assistant; no new service or incremental upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: How much time is spent locating the correct specification rather than understanding it?

already_counted.description: Instruction study, sample examination and staff clarification

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gives zero gross and net saving. Cutting workflow capabilities do not establish a saving in setup interpretation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Careful interpretation of textile production instructions
reach: Coordinate specification questions with production engineers
role.ambitious_version: An operator who understands setup requirements and resolves unclear instructions before applying them

job.title: Textile Knitting and Weaving Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
